scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: The result was harsh. But somehow, I find myself surprisingly calm.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Ah... I see. I’ve been rejected.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Thank you... for being honest with me.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: But... I really respect you, senpai! It’s just that...

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: As a heavy silence fell between them, a loud boom echoed through the night sky.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: BOOOOOOM!!!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Fireworks... they’re nice. You can just look up and stay silent—no awkwardness.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The two silently gazed at the fireworks. But when he turned to speak, Megumi had already disappeared.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Yeah... I really was rejected.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: As {{playerName}} stood alone on the beach, lost in thought, a figure suddenly appeared.

scenarios.speaker: Professor Ymoto
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}, what are you doing here all by yourself?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Professor Yasumoto... Actually, I just confessed to Megumi.

scenarios.speaker: Professor Ymoto
scenarios.text: Ah, I see. And? What was the outcome?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: She turned me down...

scenarios.speaker: Professor Ymoto
scenarios.text: I see... But, {{playerName}}, did you know that relationships within the lab are actually prohibited?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Wait... Really?

scenarios.speaker: Professor Ymoto
scenarios.text: Yes. It’s a rule to help everyone stay focused on their research. Let’s shift gears and dive back into work.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: I see... Somehow, I feel a little better now.

scenarios.speaker: Professor Ymoto
scenarios.text: Ah, youth. Come on, let’s head back to the inn. We’ve got more research to do starting tomorrow.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: And thus, {{playerName}}’s first love came to an end. But somehow, my heart feels lighter. Maybe it’s thanks to this place—Tokoname—and to Professor Yasumoto.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: GAME OVER
